# NEW 2026-11-23 v21.0 Fourth Rome (ELR / Nova Elysia) Bugfix & Comprehensive Deepening: 6 Elysian Senate Estate Parliament Agendas (oe_el4_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v210_fourth_rome.py; edit the generator, not this file.


oe_el4_pa_nobles_senatorial_stipend = {
	type = country
	estate = nobles_estate
	importance = 2.0

	potential = {
		oe_el4_is_active_elysia = yes
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_el4_mod_pa_senatorial_stipend }
	}

	on_accept = {
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_el4_mod_pa_senatorial_stipend
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
		add_estate_satisfaction = {
			type = estate_type:nobles_estate
			value = 0.05
		}
	}

	can_bribe = {
		can_bribe_default_trigger = yes
	}

	on_bribe = {
		on_bribe_default_effect = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 20
		subtract = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					estate_satisfaction = { estate_type = scope:target value > 0.6 }
				}
				value = 15
			}
		}
	}

	chance = 12
}
